section: Salary (work done outside India) + residency (days worked in India)
story: India non-resident (12 days in India, 350 in the US), Indian salary Rs 96,00,000 for work done from the US (work outside India: yes, salary-screen workdays blank), Rs 1,20,000 FD interest. Days worked in India (residency screen): 0.

expect.why: 0 days worked in India: none of the salary is for work done in India, so a non-resident isn't taxed on it (only the Rs 1,20,000 interest); the 12 days present were a visit
Rs 1,20,000 is under the Rs 4,00,000 basic exemption
Salary India can't tax isn't 'taxed under both codes': India's side of the cross-basis salary row is 0 (the US still taxes all of it)
